title: Term Life Insurance Premium Mode Terms: Monthly Bank Draft Limits and Annual Mode Timing
content:
**Term Life Insurance — monthly bank-draft (EFT) privilege and premium mode figures, identical on every tier.**

| Term | Figure on the Ashgrove Annual Renewable Term and the Ashgrove Level Term 10, 15, 20, 25 and 30 |
|---|---|
| Returned EFT drafts within a rolling 12-month window that end the EFT privilege | 2 |
| Wait after an EFT privilege termination before monthly EFT may be elected again | 6 calendar months |
| Latest draft day that may be chosen for monthly EFT | day 28 of the month |
| Change to annual mode takes effect only on a policy anniversary | yes |

### Basis Q&A

**May a draft day of the 30th be chosen?** No. The latest draft day on any tier is the 28th; days 1 through 28 may be chosen.

**What does the figure 2 count?** Returned EFT drafts on the policy within a rolling 12-month window; the second such return within the window is the one that reaches the figure.

**When may monthly EFT be elected again?** Only after 6 calendar months from the date of the return that ended the privilege.
